summary: Implemented the two-level refactor of the event handlers in the MONAI repo; nothing was run or committed. Level 1 (no ignite dependency): monai/data/nifti_saver.py adds NiftiSaver.save(data, meta_data) and the moved create_file_basename; monai/data/csv_saver.py adds CSVSaver with save() and finalize(), including the overwrite=False merge; monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py adds module-level plot_2d_or_3d_image(data, step, writer, index, max_channels, max_frames, tag), which TensorBoardImageHandler now calls. Level 2: SegmentationSaver and ClassificationSaver keep their constructors and attach behaviour and delegate to the level-1 classes. Tests added: tests/test_nifti_saver.py, test_csv_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. Docs: docs/source/data.rst lists the two new modules. Behaviour changes to review: SegmentationSaver now honours its dtype argument (previously it used the output's dtype), and the 2D multi-channel TensorBoard path now writes one image per channel instead of only the first. Not verified: no tests were run; running the new tests plus the existing classification and TensorBoard image tests is the next step.
